name: Pray for Three

features.name: Wheel of Sin
features.description: Up to three sections of adding and multiplying values.

features.name: Prayer Hands
features.description: Decide how many wheel sections activate.

features.name: Total Win Bar
features.description: Collects cascade wins before the wheel applies.

review:
Fallen angels, cascades and a Wheel of Sin next to the grid. Prayer Hands landing during a win reveal a number from one to three – how many sections of the wheel switch on. The sections mix adding multipliers up to 333x with multiplying ones up to x33.

Every win from the spin collects in the Total Win Bar before the wheel applies, so a long cascade followed by a three-section hit is the big one. The odd 13,333x max fits the theme perfectly.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
